fixes.what: Hide the branch on phones (display:none below 768px) and let the leaf band and ground band carry the painted art; or, if kept, give it a real tip: width 300px, left:-140px, top anchored to a text-free row (e.g. between #who and #pillars), mask unchanged.
fixes.why: On phone-1/phone-2 the 48px visible sliver at 60vh reads as a stray smudge, not a painted branch; it looks accidental and cheapens the frame.

fixes.where: index.html · form first .form__row (Your names / Email) + site.css .form__row
fixes.what:
Move

below the input (keep aria-describedby) so both labels in a row share one baseline; keep align-items:end for the inputs.
fixes.why: Desktop-3: the Names label sits 28px higher than the Email label; the ragged label line breaks the 2px grid discipline the rest of the form keeps.

fixes.what: Separate the arch base from the kashida: desktop .hero__shade,.hero__window{max-height:62vh} and .hero__word{bottom:calc(10vh + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}, so the arch base ends inside the Latin letters and the Persian kashida line sits ≥120px clear below it.
fixes.why: Desktop-0: the cream arch base and the cream kashida run as two parallel lines 55px apart with the Persian letters squeezed between; the lockup looks cluttered at the one moment the brand must read cleanest.

fixes.what: Below 1024px set .journey{padding-bottom:clamp(40px,6vh,64px)} and .inquire{padding-top:clamp(40px,6vh,64px)} (and shorten the journey's bottom gradient to 48px).
fixes.why: Phone-3: ~200px of empty cream between the last stop and the Inquire eyebrow; the page stalls right before the conversion section.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css · .pair on phones (Who we are, Inquire eyebrows)
fixes.what: Below 768px keep the Persian on the same row as the eyebrow: .pair{grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:baseline} with the .fa right-aligned, instead of stacking it on its own right-aligned line.
fixes.why: Phone-3: 'Inquire' sits left and 'شروع برنامه‌ریزی' sits far right on the next line, reading as two unrelated items rather than one bilingual pair.

fixes.what: Give the Persian word the same left edge as the heading: .pillar__n.fa{text-align:left} (direction stays rtl).
fixes.why: Desktop-1: آرام/محترم/سربلند hug the right edge while Calm/Respected/Proud hug the left, so each pillar reads as two mis-stacked blocks instead of one.
